To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

women-to-woman diplomacy in Georgia is a promising peacebuilding strategy because it: (1) creates alternative spaces for women to engage in peacebuilding and to develop a sense of ownership over peace; (2) provides a platform for women to build a common identity and a sense of solidarity; and (3) offers opportunities for women’s organisations to build a coalition and work towards achieving equal rights.

the women-to-women approach to diplomacy can contribute to peacebuilding in Georgia and its breakaway territories by humanising the Other, building coalitions, and creating alternative arenas of dialogue.
women-to-women diplomatic initiatives can offer opportunities for building bridges and promoting peacebuilding in frozen conflicts.
